description: This file defines the interface for an abstract class IAVBufferHelper used for handling buffer memory operations such as mapping, unmapping, size retrieval, and copying buffer data in a media or hardware abstraction layer context.

classes.name: IAVBufferHelper
classes.description: An abstract class providing an interface for buffer memory management, including mapping/unmapping memory, obtaining allocation size, writing into secure buffers, and copying secure buffer contents.

methods.name: mapHandle
methods.description: Maps memory from a given handle, returning a pointer to the mapped memory and its size.

methods.name: unmapHandle
methods.description: Unmaps memory associated with a handle, returning true if successful.

methods.name: getAllocationSize
methods.description: Retrieves the size of the memory allocated for a given handle.

methods.name: bool writeSecureHandle(uint64_t handle,void * data,uint32_t size)
methods.description: Writes data into a secure buffer identified by a handle.

methods.name: bool copySecureHandleWithMap(uint64_t handleTo,uint64_t handleFrom,CopyMap map,uint32_t mapSize)
methods.description: Copies data between secure buffers using specified offset and size mappings.

methods.name: getAVBufferHelperInstance
methods.description: Factory function that returns an instance of IAVBufferHelper.

ctags.name: copySecureHandleWithMap
ctags.pattern: /^    virtual bool copySecureHandleWithMap(uint64_t handleTo, uint64_t handleFrom, CopyMap map, ui/

ctags.name: writeSecureHandle
ctags.pattern: /^    virtual bool writeSecureHandle(uint64_t handle, void* data, uint32_t size) { return false; }$/
